caption: The drawing depicts a stylized eagle with outstretched wings that are colored in shades of brown and tan, occupying the central upper portion of the composition. The eagle’s head is turned to its right, with dark eyes and a hooked beak outlined in black. Beneath the eagle are curled elements resembling acanthus leaves in teal blue with yellow highlights, positioned symmetrically on either side. Intertwined with the leaves are scroll-like, curling tendrils in a muted reddish-pink hue. Near the center, beneath the eagle’s feet, is a scallop-shaped form in light beige and gold tones. On each side of this central form are circular elements shaded in a gradient of dark gray and reddish-brown, partially surrounded by the teal leaves and reddish scrollwork. The background is a washed gradient of dark gray, fading into lighter gray toward the top and bottom, providing contrast to the warm and cool colors of the foreground elements.
title: Hose Holder
